Minimally invasive mitral valve repair using neochords provided a high rate of repair, reproducible results in a routine cardiac surgery setting, and stable repair during follow-up. This approach has become our preferred technique for mitral valve surgery due to its advantages over traditional open-heart surgeries.

In summary, minimally invasive mitral valve repair with artificial chords is not only reproducible but also applicable in routine surgery settings. The procedure offers high success rates, excellent long-term outcomes, and stable repair during follow-up, making it an attractive option for patients requiring mitral valve replacement or repair.
